questions.question: What should a dancer generally do before vigorous practice?
choices: Use a gradual warm-up that prepares the body for movement
Skip preparation if the music is slow

questions.question: Why is proper floor and footwear awareness important?
choices: Surfaces and shoes affect traction, balance, and injury risk
They remove the need for technique

questions.question: A dancer feels sharp pain during a movement. What is the safest response?
choices: Ask a partner to push the joint

questions.question: What does neutral alignment generally support?
choices: A requirement to hold one pose all class
Efficient movement and balanced distribution of force

questions.question: Why should a dancer progress gradually when increasing training intensity?
choices: The body needs time to adapt to added demands

questions.question: Which action supports safe partner work?
choices: Communicate clearly and agree on timing and contact before a lift
Assume the partner knows every cue

questions.question: Why is hydration important during physical activity?
choices: It replaces the need for rest
It supports normal body function during exertion

questions.question: A dancer is learning a turn. What should be practiced before increasing speed?
choices: A jump combined with the turn
Balance, alignment, spotting, and controlled technique

questions.question: What is spotting in dance turns?
choices: Using a focused head movement to help orientation

questions.question: Why should dancers respect personal range of motion?
choices: Forcing beyond a safe range can cause injury

questions.question: What is a sensible way to rehearse a high-impact jump?
choices: Build technique and strength progressively with safe landing mechanics

questions.question: Why should a dancer keep pathways clear during rehearsal?
choices: To make the stage appear larger
To remove the need for choreography
To reduce collisions and support spatial awareness

questions.question: What should dancers do if a costume or prop limits movement unexpectedly?
choices: Pause and resolve the issue before continuing safely
Hide the problem from the group

questions.question: Why is rest part of training?
choices: Recovery helps the body respond to physical demands

questions.question: A teacher gives a correction about knee alignment during a landing. What is the safest next step?
choices: Ignore alignment if the landing is quiet
Apply the correction at a manageable speed and check control

questions.question: What should a dancer do after noticing persistent soreness that affects movement?
choices: Mask it and continue at full intensity
Ask a peer to diagnose it
Tell an instructor or trusted adult and seek appropriate evaluation

questions.question: Why should warm-up movements relate to the upcoming activity?
choices: They can prepare relevant joints and movement patterns
They must be identical for every dance

questions.question: Which rehearsal choice helps protect hearing when amplified music is used?
choices: Use a reasonable volume and follow venue guidance
Increase volume to cover all conversation

questions.question: Why should a dancer learn safe ways to fall or roll when required by choreography?
choices: It removes the need for floor checks
Practiced technique can reduce uncontrolled impact
It guarantees the dancer will not be injured

questions.question: Which statement best describes safe dance practice?
choices: Safety is only the instructor's responsibility
Technique, communication, appropriate preparation, and attention to the environment work together
